name: Stream Deck Bridge
description: Shows your agents on an Elgato Stream Deck: their status on keys, and taps that open a workspace, go to an agent or start one.

cover.alt: A macro keypad whose keys show one project each with its agent's logo and state: needs you, working, done, waiting

screenshots.alt: Eight keys and a touch strip showing agents per project with their logo and state
screenshots.caption: One key per workspace: the agent's logo, its state, and a dot per agent
